en.title: Burnham pledges to end the existing pension triple lock in 2030 to fund social care
en.coreFact: Andy Burnham vowed to end the existing pension triple lock in 2030 to help fund care, a move the BBC calls significant but a gamble, and a Guardian-reported poll suggests voters back cutting back the triple lock to fund social care reform by 48% to 28%.
en.whyItMatters: It links a politically protected pension guarantee to the financing of a national care service, testing whether ageing-related care costs can be funded by reworking retirement indexation rather than new borrowing.
en.processMatchReason: No existing World Process covers social care financing or pension indexation; this is a domestic welfare-fiscal shift, so no match is forced.

zh.title: 伯纳姆承诺2030年终止现行养老金三重锁以资助社会照护
zh.coreFact: 安迪·伯纳姆誓言在2030年终止现行养老金三重锁以帮助资助照护体系；BBC称此举意义重大但属赌博，卫报报道的民调显示选民以48%对28%支持削减三重锁以资助社会照护改革。
zh.whyItMatters: 该举措把受政治保护的养老金保障与国家照护服务的融资直接挂钩，检验能否通过重构退休金指数化而非新增借债来应对老龄化照护成本。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界进程不涵盖社会照护融资或养老金指数化，这是国内福利财政转向，因此不强行匹配。
